$comment: PDF import (feature 016): File > Import > PDF File..., File > Open's refusal of a PDF, the questions (the archive's PDF, the password, the FBD), the progress, the refusals and the summary. Feature catalogue merged into en.json by i18n/index.ts.

importPdf.description: Make a new book from a PDF: the editor's own PDFs come back as their books; PDFs made from text and scanned books with a text layer, best effort

pdfImport.passwordPrompt: {{name}} is protected by a password. Enter it to import the book:
pdfImport.ownerPasswordPrompt: {{name}} does not allow copying its text. Enter its owner password to import it:
pdfImport.wrongPassword: The password is not right. Try again:
pdfImport.importDone: Imported from PDF: {{pages}} pages, {{sections}} sections, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
pdfImport.importCancelled: The import was cancelled; the book in the window is unchanged.
pdfImport.openRefused: {{path}} is a PDF. File > Open takes FictionBook (FB2) books, FBD files and ZIP archives holding FB2 books; a PDF is imported with File > Import > PDF File....
pdfImport.openRefusedInArchive: {{path}} holds a PDF but no FictionBook book. A PDF is imported with File > Import > PDF File....

refused.damaged: the PDF is damaged and could not be read.
refused.tooLarge: the file is larger than the import reads (1 GB; 512 MB inside a ZIP archive).
refused.tooManyPages: the PDF has more pages than the import reads (25,000).
refused.copyForbidden: the PDF does not allow copying its text, and its owner password was not given.
refused.noText: the PDF holds pictures of its pages but no text ({{pages}} pages); the editor does not recognise text in pictures.
refused.pictureOfText: {{pages}} pages show text but have no text layer; the editor imports only PDFs whose text is all there.
refused.garbled: the PDF's text layer reads mostly as garbage.
refused.memory: reading the PDF took more memory than the import allows.
refused.timeout: reading the PDF stopped making progress.
refused.crashed: the PDF could not be read: its reader stopped.
refused.encrypted: the archive is protected by a password.

pdfImport.summaryIntro: Not everything came over as the PDF has it:
